# 数据处理与 microtable 构建

本项目使用 `microeco` 软件包进行数据分析。这里从 DADA2 的输出结果和 `info.xlsx` 元数据文件构建所需的 `microtable` 对象。

## 载入包

```{r}
#| label: data-load-packages
library(tidyverse)
library(microeco)
library(readxl)
library(jsonlite)
source("figure-notes.R")
```

## 读取 DADA2 结果

```{r}
#| label: read-dada2-results
PATH = "data/dada2-result"

# OTU/ASV 表
otu_table = read_csv(file.path(PATH, "asv-table.csv"))
otu_table = column_to_rownames(otu_table, var = names(otu_table)[1])
rownames(otu_table) = str_remove(rownames(otu_table), "_F_filt\\.fq\\.gz$")
```

```{r}
#| label: check-otu-table
cat("ASV 表维度:", dim(otu_table), "\n")
cat("样本数:", nrow(otu_table), "\n")
cat("ASV 数:", ncol(otu_table), "\n")
```

### 整理 ASV 表格式

`microeco` 对 `otu_table` 的格式有严格要求：**行必须是 Taxa（ASV），列必须是 Samples**。

```{r}
#| label: transpose-otu-table
# DADA2 输出的 ASV 表是：行=样本，列=ASV；microeco 需要：行=ASV，列=样本。
otu_table = t(otu_table) |> as.data.frame(check.names = FALSE)
```

## 构建样本元数据表

从 `info.xlsx` 提取样品分组信息。

```{r}
#| label: build-sample-table
info = read_excel("info.xlsx") |> janitor::clean_names()

# 查看 info 的列名
names(info)
```

```{r}
#| label: build-sample-table-parse
sample_table = info |>
    filter(!is.na(sample_id)) |>
    select(
        sample_name = sample_id,
        group = yang_pin_suo_shu_fen_zu_ming_cheng,
        breed,
        genotype
    ) |>
    mutate(
        group = factor(group, levels = c("A", "B", "C")),
        breed = factor(breed, levels = c("Duroc", "Landrace", "Yorkshire")),
        genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("AA", "GA", "GG"))
    ) |>
    column_to_rownames(var = "sample_name")

cat("样本元数据表维度:", dim(sample_table), "\n")
cat("各分组样本数:\n")
print(table(sample_table$group))
cat("\n各品种样本数:\n")
print(table(sample_table$breed))
cat("\n各基因型样本数:\n")
print(table(sample_table$genotype))
```

## 读取分类学表格

```{r}
#| label: read-taxonomy
taxon_table = read_csv(file.path(PATH, "tax-table.csv"))
taxon_table = column_to_rownames(taxon_table, var = names(taxon_table)[1]) |>
  tidy_taxonomy()
```

## 汇总序列量

```{r}
#| label: data-check-sample-sums
sample_sums = colSums(otu_table)
cat("各样本序列量统计:\n")
summary(sample_sums)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-sample-sums
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 10
data.frame(sample = names(sample_sums), reads = sample_sums) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(sample, reads), y = reads)) +
    geom_col() +
    labs(x = "样本", y = "序列数") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 4))
```


```{r}
#| label: plot-sample-sums-note
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
render_figure_note("plot-sample-sums")
```

## 构建 microtable 对象

```{r}
#| label: data-create-microtable
mt = microtable$new(
    otu_table = otu_table,
    sample_table = sample_table,
    tax_table = taxon_table
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tidy-microtable
# 剔除没有门水平分类的 ASV（通常是未比对上的噪音序列）
mt$tax_table = subset(mt$tax_table, !is.na(Phylum))
mt$tidy_dataset()

cat("整理后的 microtable 对象:\n")
cat("- ASV 数:", nrow(mt$otu_table), "\n")
cat("- 样本数:", ncol(mt$otu_table), "\n")
```

## 保存处理好的表格

```{r}
#| label: save-microeco-tables
dir.create("data/amplicon-sequencing", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

write.csv(mt$otu_table, file = "data/amplicon-sequencing/otu_table_mt.csv", row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(mt$sample_table, file = "data/amplicon-sequencing/sample_table_mt.csv", row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(mt$tax_table, file = "data/amplicon-sequencing/taxon_table_mt.csv", row.names = TRUE)

cat("表格已保存至 data/amplicon-sequencing/\n")
```
